facts.statement: The genus Huoshanornis was first named in 2010 by Xia Wang, Zihui Zhang, Chunling Gao, Lianhai Hou, Qingjin Meng, and Jinyuan Liu.
facts.quote: It was first named by Xia Wang, Zihui Zhang, Chunling Gao, Lianhai Hou, Qingjin Meng and Jinyuan Liu in 2010

facts.statement: Huoshanornis is classified as a genus of enantiornithine birds.
facts.quote: Huoshanornis is a genus of enantiornithine birds

facts.statement: Huoshanornis lived during the Early Cretaceous period in the Jiufotang Formation of Western Liaoning Province, China.
facts.quote: existed in what is now Jiufotang Formation of Western Liaoning Province, China during the early Cretaceous period

facts.statement: Fossil remains of Huoshanornis were discovered at Chaoyang City.
facts.quote: Its fossil remains were found at Chaoyang City

facts.statement: The parent group of Huoshanornis is Enantiornithes.
Huoshanornis lived between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago during the Aptian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)
